values.heading: Cleaning, Diagnostics, And Repair For Heavy-Duty Trucks
values.text:
Winslow-Gerolamy Motors Limited provides DPF cleaning, emissions diagnostics, and repair services for heavy-duty trucks across Central Ontario.

Modern diesel engines rely on emissions systems such as DPF, DEF, SCR, and EGR to maintain performance and meet regulatory requirements. Our service team is focused on keeping these systems operating efficiently to prevent downtime and maintain compliance.

image.alt: A yellow dump truck and a truck raised on lifts in the Winslow-Gerolamy service shop

textColumns.heading: Our Approach To Emissions Service
textColumns.text:
The service department at Winslow-Gerolamy Motors prides itself on providing an outstanding customer service experience with operational excellence. Our number one priority is to keep our customers' businesses moving and growing.

Our highly skilled, professional staff work to maximize uptime through timely repairs and help lower operating costs through preventative maintenance. Our technicians are 310T certified and OEM trained.

textColumns.heading: Certified Technicians & OEM Support

textColumns.textAfter: All emissions diagnostics, repairs, and warranty work are completed to manufacturer standards using approved tools and procedures.

values.heading: DPF Cleaning Services
values.text:
We provide professional Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) cleaning to remove soot and ash buildup that can restrict airflow and reduce performance.

Our DPF cleaning process includes:

points.text: Cleaning to remove accumulated soot and ash

values.textAfter:
Regular cleaning helps extend filter life, improve engine efficiency, and reduce the risk of system failure.

DPF units can be dropped off at the service department and are typically ready for pickup the following day.

image.alt: A DPF cleaned here: a diesel particulate filter marked 'clean me' with the slogan Run Clean. Run Efficiently. Save Money.
